title: Polity crosswalk
description: Hand-written, in an import folder (data/imports/<name>/polity-crosswalk.yaml): which of our polities goes with each of the import's own units, and when. A list of units.

unit.description: A polity record in the same import folder.

polity.description: One of our polities, in data/polities/.

kind.description: same-state: our polity is the same state as the unit. dependency: our polity administered a territory the import codes as the unit's colony, protectorate, or occupied territory.

until.description: First day the match no longer applies.
